evidence.detail: load_matchups returns all archetypes including sub-archetypes via a plain INNER JOIN on the archetype table; no parent-level filtering
matchups dict is built from a copy of all archetypes passed in; sub-archetypes appear in the grid alongside top-level archetypes without any special treatment
Archetypes have a .parent attribute available; filtering or annotating sub-archetypes is structurally feasible but the desired display behavior is unspecified

triage.notes: The decision needed is: should sub-archetypes be filtered from the grid, shown with their parent label, or something else? Multiple reasonable approaches exist (roll up into parent totals, display as 'Parent > Child', hide rows below a threshold), each with different trade-offs for completeness vs. clarity.
